definitions.missingResearchDates: Legacy probe field name: count of index rows where BOTH last_activity and last_human_review are null. These are service activity/review fields. This does NOT count missing publication, research-result, or website edit dates.
definitions.contextApproximateTokens: Implementation estimate of retained section text using character count / 4; excludes JSON envelope, surrounding metadata and protocol framing. Not measured client/model tokens.
definitions.petzRecoveryRank: One-based rank of Ordinary-Petz recovery bound for conditional mutual information in the returned rows; zero means absent.
